applies_to: Public & private owners and operators of personal databases
key_requirements: Consent, registration of personal databases, local storage of Uzbek citizens' data, data subject rights
retention_period: Art. 10: storage period determined by date purposes of collection/processing are achieved; identifiable only as purposes require; destroy when purpose met
enforcement_authority: Personalization Agency under the Ministry of Justice
penalties_range: Administrative fines up to 50 base values; criminal liability for repeat offences
exemptions: Household use; state secrets; defence & national security information
research_exemption: Archival documents listed among exclusions from the law's scope (art. 3); no specific scientific/statistical research exemption found (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Biometric and genetic data subject to more stringent requirements (art. 7 on biometric and genetic data)
notes: Localization rule (2021) narrowed by Mar 2026 amendment; adequacy list of 49 countries set Jul 2026
